```yaml
name: Build CLI Native Archives

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      os:
        required: true
        type: string
      arch:
        required: true
        type: string
      runtime:
        required: true
        type: string
      publish-artifacts:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
    secrets:
      CODECOV_TOKEN:
        required: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore src/Aspire.Hosting/Aspire.Hosting.csproj

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build src/Aspire.Hosting/Aspire.Hosting.csproj --no-restore -c Release

      - name: Publish
        run: dotnet publish src/Aspire.Hosting/Aspire.Hosting.csproj -c Release -o ./publish --self-contained -r ${{ inputs.runtime }}

      - name: Create Archive
        run: |
          cd ./publish
          tar -czf aspire-cli-${{ inputs.os }}-${{ inputs.arch }}.tar.gz .

      - name: Upload Artifact
        if: inputs.publish-artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: aspire-cli-${{ inputs.os }}-${{ inputs.arch }}
          path: ./publish/aspire-cli-${{ inputs.os }}-${{ inputs.arch }}.tar.gz
```
